Name: DecorativeGardenPots.AT
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[u][b][size=4]Features and Options:[/size][/b][/u]

This is an Alternative Texture pack of Garden Pots and can be applied to the vanilla "Garden Pot" crafting item in the game.

The Garden Pot is a crafted item that allows crops to be grown indoors.[i] [/i]It can also be used to grow crops on The Farm or the Ginger Island Farm. (They will need to be watered daily with the watering can). You will receive a Garden Pot from Evelyn after the greenhouse is repaired - this is accomplished by completing the Pantry Bundle. Evelyn will also provide you with the Crafting recipe for the Garden Pot. Personally, I never really used the Garden Pot because I thought it was ugly and didn't match with any other furniture when I decorated the farmhouse. This mod will give you the opportunity to transform it into a lovely decorative pot!

There are currently 40 textures available. I wanted to upload all of the images from my Decorative Pots mod, but due to the placement of the seeds, they didn't align properly. So I took the basic design and re-vamped them to match the Garden Pot dimensions. 

The best part is you can use them to grow crops and flowers from seeds. I used seeds from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999?tab=description]Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats/mods?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url] as well as the flower seeds from Pierre's General Store. I haven't tried planting any crops in the Garden Pots yet...

Please note: the Garden Pot is a Crafting item, so it cannot be moved around like regular furniture via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url], which is a darn shame. If there is a way around that, please let me know!

(In the meantime, I ended up liking the design of these Garden Pots so much that I included the images in my Decorative Pots mod).


[size=4][b][u]Installation & Usage:[/u][/b][/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=http://][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url]﻿﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿﻿
[*]﻿Download the "[b](AT) Decorative Garden Pots[/b]" file and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Use the "Paint Bucket" tool purchased from Robin's shop to change the textures of the Garden Pot.
[*]As a reminder: the Garden Pot and crafting recipe will be given to you from Evelyn after you fix the Greenhouse. (This is accomplished by completing the Pantry Bundle).
[*]I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to make life much easier. (I use it to get the Garden Pots and flower seeds).
[/list]
